parsed.post: Discarding the last experiment (1.066) as it failed to beat the depth 6 baseline (1.029). Returning to commit 023aaea. I suspect the recent failure was due to an imbalance in capacity vs learning rate. Testing a lower learning rate now to see if it yields more stable convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.01 to stabilize training for the DEPTH=6 architecture.
